template.titlePattern: Your First 24 Hours in {city}, Dealt as Cards
template.searchQuery: essential local food culture landmarks first visit
template.editorialBrief: Build a plausible first-day sequence, not a top-ten list. Give each card a role in the day and one clear reason it belongs there. Keep travel time and opening-hour claims conservative unless verified. Avoid bucket-list language and exhausting itinerary compression.
